notes.title: The Pub Life Simulator Demo – 0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 👋

Thanks to your valuable feedback, another exciting update for the demo is now live! 🎉 We’ve fixed bugs and added some great new features. Here are the details 👇

[h2][b]FIXES:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Customer sounds can now be adjusted.

[*] Interaction highlight now appears when placing items on tables.

[*] UI improvements have been made.

[*] Save system has been updated.

[*] Product prices have been revised.
 
[*] The maximum day limit is now set to 7.

[*] The exterior door can now be closed after 24:00.

[*] Customer waiting time has been increased to 50 seconds.

[*] Fixed the issue where items would clip into each other.

[*] Fixed a bug where orders couldn’t be placed in the store during the tutorial.
[/list]

[h2][b]NEW FEATURES:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] 2K resolution (2048x1080) support added.
 
[*] Added language support for German, French, Italian, Castilian Spanish, Portuguese (Portugal), Latin American Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

[*] The game now pauses when you press ESC.

[*] A horizontal scroll bar has been added to the store interface.

[*] Customer order bubbles, payment screens, and product info cards have been completely redesigned for a clearer and more modern look.

[*] Added a system where customers can walk around outside.

[*] New drink types: Whiskey, Vodka, Wine, and Gin are now included.
[/list]

💬 We’re improving every day thanks to your feedback!
Please don’t forget to share your suggestions and bug reports with us on our Discord channel:
[url=https://discord.gg/thepublifesimulator][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45339823/82c85625c91562d39cfd650da41d5c36b868597f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Minor Update – Patch Notes v0.1.1
notes.notes:
[h2][b]🛠️ The Pub Life Simulator Demo Minor Update – Patch Notes v0.1.1[/b][/h2]

Hey everyone! 👋

We’ve released a small update based on the feedback we received after the demo launch. Here’s what’s been improved:

[b]✔️ FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

[list]
[*] The front pub door now only opens in one direction — no more awkward customer collisions! 🚪

[*] The "OPEN" LED sign now turns off properly at 24:00.

[*] Glasses now spawn correctly at the start of each new day.

[*] Fixed a bug where placing another object in the keg area prevented the keg from appearing.

[*] Main menu and ESC menu buttons now respond to clicks correctly.

[*] Trash bins behind the pub are now functional — you can finally throw stuff away! 🗑️

[*] Fixed an issue where the character could get stuck after pressing the back button on the tablet.

[*] Fixed a bug where removing items from the cart didn’t update the total price.

[*] Turkish language support has been added! 🇹🇷

[*] Updated the background for customer order prompts for better clarity.

[*] Fixed a visual bug related to item placement holograms.
[/list]

💬 Your feedback helps us improve the game every day.
Feel free to share your thoughts or bug reports with us on our Discord server:
[url=https://discord.gg/thepublifesimulator][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45339823/82c85625c91562d39cfd650da41d5c36b868597f.png[/img][/url]
